generated_by: Swift FleetMarketIndex.build + FleetMarketHeadline (mobile/rsibot-ios); expected values are never edited by hand

rules.mean: equal-weight mean of base-100 pair lines, 1.5-interval carry, sums left to right in expected_pairs order
rules.spark: last mean value per 30-minute UTC bucket (floor(time_ms / 1800000)), oldest first, newest 48, each round_half_away_from_zero(value * 100) / 100
rules.value: last mean value, same rounding, printed with 2 decimals
rules.change_pct: (last mean value - 100), same rounding, printed with 2 decimals; -0.00 prints as 0.00
rules.stale: FleetMarketIndex.isStale(at: now): explicit stale source, missing pair, or age > 1.5 intervals

cases.name: live
cases.description: Real live 1D pair responses (3 bots x 5 pairs, 2026-10-13); equal-length ties keep the first input.

cases.name: gap_segment_break
cases.description: A has no candles for minutes 6-9 (gap > 1.5 intervals): the mean has no points while A cannot be carried.

cases.name: candle_hygiene
cases.description: Duplicate time (last wins), out-of-order candle, close 0 and -1 skipped, newest candle not closed at receipt (excluded).

cases.name: baseline_moves_stale_baseline_missing_pair
cases.description: B starts at minute 3 (baseline moves there); C's last candle before it is 120 s old (dropped as stale baseline); D has no input. Missing pairs make the index stale.

cases.name: duplicate_inputs
cases.description: A: bot2's 7 candles beat bot1's 5. B: equal length, bot1 (first input) wins.

cases.name: stale_source_and_source_age
cases.description: A reports freshness_state stale (index stale); B reports source_age_seconds 42.
